# VFX India

> > VFX India is an online education platform offering courses and tutorials in graphic design, video editing, VFX, and digital marketing for creative professionals and beginners.

The platform specializes in practical training for Adobe Creative Cloud tools (Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects), video editing software (DaVinci Resolve), 3D tools (Blender), and design platforms (Canva, Figma). VFX India provides career-focused courses for media, entertainment, and ecommerce marketing, with emphasis on portfolio-building and self-taught learning paths.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Creative Cloud
- Adobe Illustrator
- Photoshop
- Canva
- Figma
- Blender
- Camera Tracking
- Match-Moving
- 3D Integration
- Video Editing
- VFX Compositing
- Graphic Design Career
- Portfolio Building
- DaVinci Resolve
- AI Design Tools

## Online Courses

- [Master Online Print Design Course for Media and Entertainment 2025](https://vfxindia.in/courses/online-print-design-course-for-media-and-entertainment): Print design course covering Adobe Illustrator for media marketing materials
- [Visual Design for Marketing online course 2025: Boost Your Creative Edge](https://vfxindia.in/courses/visual-design-for-marketing-online-course): Marketing visual design course using Adobe Creative Cloud and Canva
- [Master Video Editing for Beginners Online Course: Start Creating 2025](https://vfxindia.in/courses/video-editing-for-beginners-online-course): Beginner video editing course for YouTube and social media content
- [Best DaVinci Resolve for YouTubers Online Course: Edit & Grade 07](https://vfxindia.in/courses/davinci-resolve-for-youtubers-online-course): DaVinci Resolve course for YouTube video editing and color grading
- [Unlock Powerful ECommerce Marketing Online Course: Shopify & WooCommerce in 2025](https://vfxindia.in/courses/ecommerce-marketing-online-course-woocommerce): Ecommerce marketing course for Shopify and WooCommerce platforms

## VFX & Camera Tracking Tutorials

- [Transform Your Projects with Camera Tracking in Blender - WELCOME To VFX](https://vfxindia.in/camera-tracking-in-blender): Blender camera tracking tutorial for 3D integration in live-action footage
- [Essential Tips for Camera Tracking in After Effects - WELCOME To VFX](https://vfxindia.in/camera-tracking-in-after-effects): After Effects 3D Camera Tracker tutorial for VFX match-moving
- [Transform Your Videos with This Green Screen Lighting Setup](https://vfxindia.in/green-screen-lighting-setup): Tutorial on professional green screen lighting for chroma key compositing

## Graphic Design Career Guides

- [How to Start a Career in Graphic Design with No Experience](https://vfxindia.in/how-to-start-a-career-in-graphic-design-no-experience): Beginner guide to starting graphic design career using Adobe, Canva tools
- [10 Graphic Design Projects You Can Start Today](https://vfxindia.in/10-graphic-design-projects-you-can-start-today): Portfolio-building projects using Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Canva
- [How to Choose the Right Online Graphic Design Course 2025](https://vfxindia.in/choose-the-right-online-graphic-design-course): Guide to selecting graphic design courses based on goals and skill level

## AI Tools & Design Automation

- [Must Have AI Tools for Graphic Designers 2025](https://vfxindia.in/must-have-ai-tools-for-graphic-designers-2025): AI design tools guide featuring Adobe Firefly, Canva, DALL·E 3
- [How AI Graphic Design Boosts Social Media Engagement 2025](https://vfxindia.in/how-ai-graphic-design-boosts-social-media-engagement): Using AI tools like Canva and DALL-E for social media visual content
